certification_scope: Certify complete SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 freshness, fixed-size ArchiveRfcResultV1 replay, operation-scoped restore and constant-cardinality archive audit JSON/result refs without imposing a branch-member business cap.

scenarios.name: archive_scope_and_audit_are_cardinality_safe
prove: SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 matches both published golden vectors and changes when any member identity, revision or archive_state changes
ArchiveRfcRequestV1 carries only scope_kind and reviewed_scope_fingerprint; it never carries a member revision list or other unbounded branch payload
writer recomputes the complete current scope under the authoritative UnitOfWork and exact-compares reviewed_scope_fingerprint before mutation
a reviewed_branch with more members than Foundation audit max_collection_items remains valid and archives every active reviewed member without truncation or an invented business cap
archive audit JSON remains fixed-shape with scalar counts and has exactly one audit result ref to rfc_archive_operation regardless of changed member cardinality
exact changed RFC identities remain only in immutable rfc_archive_operation_members/rfc_archive_events row-wise authority
ArchiveRfc material and NO_CHANGE responses are fixed-size ArchiveRfcResultV1; NO_CHANGE has null rfc_archive_operation_id and creates no operation/event/audit
same command_id replay returns the original exact ArchiveRfcResultV1 before current scope reads and creates no second operation/event/audit

scenarios.name: archive_restore_audit_is_operation_bounded
prove: RestoreRfcArchiveOperation considers every immutable origin member but restores only members still archived by that exact operation
a newer independent restore/rearchive wins and an older operation never overwrites later provenance
restore audit remains fixed-shape with scalar changed_rfc_count and exactly one audit result ref to the origin rfc_archive_operation even when many members restore
restored identities remain row-wise rfc_archive_events for the restore command
zero eligible members is semantic NO_CHANGE with no restored event or audit
